relation: one supplied qualitative criterion partitions one finite object set into retained and excluded subsets

stageEvents.observable: five source objects are simultaneously readable as one unsorted set
one qualitative criterion becomes the sole active test
each source object visibly receives a keep or exclude verdict from that criterion
all objects occupy exactly one of two labeled subsets while both subsets remain visible
the retained subset resolves as the selected result without hiding excluded evidence

limits: every object belongs to exactly one of retained or excluded
both retained and excluded subsets must be non-empty
no numeric conversion rate, ranking, weighting, probability, or throughput
no nested condition, sequential pipeline, merge, loop, or causal claim
